title: Unit – 1 : Session – 11 : SLO – 1  |  EX-OR gate
sections: 1. EX-OR Logic Expression — b) A⊕B = A̅B + AB̅
2. Output Condition — a) 0 when inputs are equal
5. Major Application — e) Half Adder and Parity Checker
Logic operation: EX-OR outputs logic 1 only when the two inputs DIFFER. Boolean expression: Y = A⊕B = A̅B + AB̅.
Circuit symbol: OR symbol with an extra curved line at the input side.

Practical application: parity generator/checker in data communication and the SUM output of a Half Adder (Sum = A⊕B, Carry = A·B). Experimental verification: applying all four input combinations to the gate reproduces the truth table exactly.
